description: Lime kiln vessel: an FBRK shell holding a CAO (quicklime) charge, ready for field slaking.
name: lime_kiln
why: FBRK (fired clay brick, vitrifies ~1150 C) is a real historic kiln-shell material with a comfortable margin under CAO's own 2613 C melt point. The CAO charge here represents the finished quicklime product of a real kiln (limestone calcination itself needs LMST, not in the live element set) -- add WATR or DSTW to trigger the genuine exothermic slaking reaction (+300 K, converts to CLST hydrated lime). Do the water-add step in a ventilated/open cell: real quicklime slaking is vigorous and the vessel heats fast.
